{{Quote|I know. I still miss her too.|[[Princess/Legends|Princess]] [[Kneesaa a Jari Kintaka/Legends|Kneesaa]] to [[Asha/Legends|Asha]], about Ra-Lee|<ref name="Asha (episode)" />}}
'''Ra-Lee''' was the wife of [[Chirpa/Legends|Chirpa]] and the mother of [[Asha/Legends|Asha]] and [[Kneesaa a Jari Kintaka/Legends|Kneesaa]]. She was killed by a [[hanadak]] when protecting her daughters Asha and Kneesaa, when Kneesaa was just a [[Wokling/Legends|wokling]].<ref name="Asha (episode)" /> Ra-Lee shared her name with a [[Ra-Lee (spirit)|nature spirit]] in Ewok mythology.<ref name="GCG">''[[Galactic Campaign Guide]]''</ref>

==Personality and traits==
Ra-Lee had tan colored [[Hair/Legends|hair]],<ref name="CSWE" /> black [[Eye/Legends|eyes]],<ref name="Asha (episode)" /> and was considered beautiful.<ref name="CSWE" />
